# Introduction

In this post, I will explore the Palmer Penguins dataset using Python. 
I will compare the body mass and flipper length of the three penguin species 
and create a small summary of the data.

The data comes from the [Palmer Penguins dataset](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), 
collected by Palmer Station Antarctica LTER. The dataset is available directly 
through the `palmerpenguins` Python package.

# Load the data

```{python}
#| echo: true

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()

penguins.head()
```

The dataset contains measurements for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo penguins.
The columns contain information such as species, island, bill measurements,
flipper length, body mass, and sex.

# Clean the data

```{python}
#| echo: true

penguins_clean = penguins[
    [
        "species",
        "island",
        "bill_length_mm",
        "flipper_length_mm",
        "body_mass_g"
    ]
].dropna()

print("Cleaned Penguin dataset with ",penguins_clean.shape[0]," rows and ",penguins_clean.shape[1]," columns:")
penguins_clean
```

Here I have selected the variables that I want to analyse, while removing the observations with missing values. This makes the summary calculations in the next step much easier to interpret.

# Compare the species

```{python}
#| echo: true

species_summary = (
    penguins_clean
    .groupby("species")
    .agg(
        number_of_penguins = ("species", "size"),
        average_body_mass_g = ("body_mass_g", "mean"),
        average_flipper_length_mm = ("flipper_length_mm", "mean")
    )
    .round(1)
)

species_summary.sort_values(by=["average_body_mass_g","average_flipper_length_mm"],ascending = False)
```

The summary table shows clear differences between the three penguin species.
In particular, Gentoo penguins tend to have a larger average body mass and
longer flippers than Adelie and Chinstrap penguins.

# Find the species with the highest average body mass

```{python}
#| echo: true

heaviest_species = species_summary["average_body_mass_g"].idxmax()

print("Species with the highest average body mass:", heaviest_species)
```

This confirms from the calculated summary that Gentoo penguins have the
highest average body mass in this dataset.

# Conclusion

This small analysis demonstrates that the three penguin species differ in
their physical measurements. Gentoo penguins stand out because they are,
on average, heavier and have longer flippers than the other two species.
